audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers store Wukong / Wukong / Wukong / Wukong / Skill / Nasus / Nasus, but the whys sitting under those rows describe a different chart entirely: whys[0] literally ends 'so it reads Skill', whys[2] says 'the lane settles into even farming', whys[3] says 'Levels 4-5 stay even'. packet.levelChart is Skill / Wukong / Skill / Skill / Skill / Nasus / Nasus and matches the whys row for row.
audit.why: 51.14% is a coin-flip lane, not a four-row Wukong sweep. The whys and the packet chart agree with each other and with the win rate; the stored sides are the outlier.
audit.corrected: Flipped rows 0, 2 and 3 from Wukong to Skill in BOTH layers as one atomic paired group, with ratings moved to 5/10 on each. Rows 1, 4, 5 and 6 already matched and are untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fury of the Sands is treated only as damage. Nothing on the page mentions that it grants him bonus attack range, bonus Armor and Magic Resist, and a reduced Siphoning Strike cooldown for its duration.
audit.why: That is the whole level 6 and late spike: his R is not a burst button, it is a window where he out-ranges your auto, tanks your Q shred, and swings Siphoning Strike far more often. Committing into it and expecting a normal duel is how the fight is lost.
audit.corrected: Wrote the range, resistances and Q-cooldown reduction into spikes[3].text and the cooldown lines. Timings and the four-entry structure untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. (a) spikes[1].text asserts Wither 'slows you 95%' — no percentage appears anywhere in Riot's description, which says only that it decelerates Move Speed and Attack Speed over time. (b) Spirit Fire (E) is absent from the entire page, despite being a 650-range zone on a flat 12-second cooldown that REDUCES YOUR ARMOR while you stand in it.
audit.why: A number the data cannot support should not be on a paying page; and Spirit Fire is the reason a Nasus can win a trade he should lose — he drops it under you and your effective armor falls while his stacked Q lands. It also shoves the wave, which is what stops your freeze.
audit.corrected: Removed the 95% figure and described Wither by what Riot actually states (move AND attack speed deceleration, 700 range, 15s at rank 1). Added Spirit Fire's armor reduction, 650 range and 12s cooldown to the don'ts and the cooldown breakdown, and gave Siphoning Strike its real 7.5s-to-3.5s cooldown so 'his Q CD is long early' is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is headed 'Fight inside his W slow' but its body reads 'Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown', which is about a spell of yours and matches nothing.
audit.why: Leftover boilerplate under a real heading; the reader gets no cooldown to play around.
audit.corrected: Rewrote it around Wither's 700 range and 15/14/13/12/11s cooldown.

notes: The 95% Wither slow figure was on the page and is not in Riot's description, which gives no percentage and states the deceleration ramps over time on both move and attack speed — I removed the number rather than restate it. Spirit Fire was completely absent from every field despite being the ability that loses Wukong the trades he should win, so it is now in the spikes, the don'ts and the cooldown breakdown. 'Stone Skin' in spikes[2] is correct and was left alone — it is Wukong's own passive, not a misnamed Nasus ability. Not asserted because the data cannot settle it: whether Wither is cleansable/QSS-able or reduced by tenacity, and whether Cyclone's knockup can interrupt anything of his. Note also that packet.games is 352 while the brief header says 828 — a human should reconcile which figure the page shows.
